title: Public key directories and public calendars of an e-mail address (manual, privacy)

links.label: Google Calendar public ICS of the address (opens the calendar feed; analyst-typed seeds only)
links.notes: P093 cond 3 (P311): the module google_calendar_ics stores only that a public calendar exists, the event count, the date range and the time zone; event titles, descriptions, locations, attendees and organizers are shown to the analyst only through this manual link. Use it for analyst-typed seed addresses only (privacy badge). Google answers 404 for private calendars and nonexistent accounts alike.

links.label: keyserver.ubuntu.com - OpenPGP keys listing the value (UIDs are unverified self-published claims)
links.notes: P091: anyone can upload a key with any user ID to this keyserver (confidence <= 0.3). A domain-wide search harvests the addresses of a whole organisation: use it only for org-profile domains or the case company's domain with a recorded purpose (P091 cond 5).

links.label: keys.openpgp.org - key with e-mail-verified user IDs
links.notes: P091: only addresses the key owner confirmed are published (PROBABLE identity link); 'No key found' means no key published there, never that the address or person does not exist.
